node.title: XR rank-five base residual has a near-saturated collision-line core
node.statement: In the RowC rank-five u=v=0 branch, choose 4+h agreements per selected codeword. P-B has pair cap three, so four-bases are unique and its three exact counts are below 8n^3. For P-A, a peeling argument on the C(N,4) kernel bases shows that any counterexample contains a nonempty subfamily in which every member lies on at least 125/123/31 distinct collision lines at rates 1/4,1/8,1/16, out of only 126/126/35 possible bases. The per-line post-strip caps are 153/179/320. This is a structural reduction, not a payment of the P-A line-rich core.
